sourceChecks.note: The exact retailer page independently validates reference 420059, current $164 sale price, add-to-cart status, 39 x 15 x 46 mm geometry, 18 mm bracelet width, stainless-steel case and bracelet, 2416 automatic/manual-winding movement, -20/+60 seconds per day, at least 31 hours of reserve, screw-down crown, 200 m water resistance, plastic crystal, and a date display.

Meranom explicitly identifies itself as a Chistopol retailer close to—not part of—the factory, states that factory warranty is supported, and says that it sells new watches. Its product facts remain reviewed secondary evidence rather than manufacturer-primary evidence.

The exact-reference specialist listing reports an approximately 128 g full weight for the steel-bracelet configuration and independently corroborates the geometry, movement, rate, reserve, crystal, water resistance, and luminous-paint presence.
A separate exact-reference Vostok dealer also reports 128 g for the stainless-steel bracelet configuration, corroborating the full-weight value.

A verified-purchase exact-reference owner calls the lume underwhelming, but supplies no controlled duration or intensity measurement and does not identify the production batch. A lone qualitative account does not establish a current repeatable lume grade.

The specialist's replacement 420 case includes spring bars for the band connection, but it is a dealer-supplied component rather than manufacturer service evidence for the factory bracelet on exact reference 420059. It does not meet the catalogue's physical-interface corroboration policy.
